name: Fort Bend Independent School District
districtFact: Fort Bend ISD is Texas' sixth-largest school district, serving more than 79,000 students across 83 campuses in Fort Bend County communities including Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, and Stafford-area neighborhoods.

about.title: About This District Calendar
about.content: Fort Bend ISD's instructional calendar covers districtwide attendance dates for campuses across Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond and nearby Fort Bend County communities. Campus calendars remain the source for testing, athletics, performances, graduation activities and school-specific events.

planningTips.title: Helpful Reminders for Fort Bend ISD Families
content: Add teacher planning and professional learning days to family calendars because Fort Bend ISD lists several no-student days outside the major holiday breaks.

Watch elementary-only and secondary-only early release dates separately. Fort Bend ISD lists early release dates that may apply to elementary campuses, middle/high schools, or all students depending on the date.
Check the district calendar after weather closures. Dates marked as possible inclement weather make-up days may become instructional days.

Use campus communications for testing, fine arts, athletics, graduation, and school-specific events. The district calendar is the right source for districtwide attendance planning, not every campus activity.

compareIntro: Compare Fort Bend ISD with other Greater Houston school calendars, including Houston ISD, Katy ISD, and Cypress-Fairbanks ISD. Dates shown include the first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, early release context, and instructional-day counts when available.

districtFaqs.q: Where is Fort Bend ISD located?
districtFaqs.a: Fort Bend ISD is based in Sugar Land, Texas and serves Fort Bend County communities in the Greater Houston area, including Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, and nearby neighborhoods.

districtFaqs.q: Does Fort Bend ISD use a traditional school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The Fort Bend ISD instructional calendar is a traditional school-year calendar with August start dates, semester grading periods, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, and a late-May ending date.

districtFaqs.q: Does Fort Bend ISD have early release days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Fort Bend ISD publishes early release dates on its instructional calendar. Some are listed for elementary campuses, some for middle and high schools, and some for all students, so families should check the date label before arranging pickup or after-school care.

districtFaqs.q: Can Fort Bend ISD calendar dates change?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Weather closures, board action, or operational needs can change a published calendar. Fort Bend ISD also marks some holidays as possible inclement weather make-up days, so families should re-check official district announcements after weather or emergency closures.

districtFaqs.q: Does Fort Bend ISD calendar apply to every campus?
districtFaqs.a: The district calendar covers major districtwide dates for Fort Bend ISD. Individual campuses may publish additional dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation activities, and school-specific events.

districtFaqs.q: How can families check for emergency schedule changes?
districtFaqs.a: Check Fort Bend ISD alerts, the district website and messages from your child's campus for weather closures, delayed starts, early dismissals or other emergency schedule changes.

districtFaqs.q: When should families check the Fort Bend ISD calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Families should review the calendar before summer planning, holiday travel, childcare arrangements, early release days, and weather season schedule changes.

customSections.label: For Families in Fort Bend County
customSections.content: Families in Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond and nearby Fort Bend County communities can use these districtwide dates for attendance, childcare and travel. Check your campus calendar separately for testing, athletics, performances and school events.
